title: AVID POWER 12V Cordless Drill, 3/8-Inch Keyless Chuck, High-Speed 1400 RPM & 25+1 Torque Control, Electric Power Drill Kit with 21pcs Bits, Battery and Charger
features: 【Precise Control of Torque and Speed】 With a maximum torque of 22N·m, this 12V electric drill effortlessly handles a wide range of household tasks from assembling furniture to drilling into wood 13/16-Inch(20mm) or steel plate 3/8-Inch (10mm). Equipped with a 1,400 RPM high-speed motor, 2-speed selection, and 25+1 torque settings, it offers precise control of torque and speed, making it an ideal tool for home repair and DIY projects

【Superior Battery Life】 One time charge, long time use. This electric drill comes with a 2000mAh lithium lon rechargeable battery, which ensure long-term operation. Usually it takes 3-5 hours to fully charge. Note: This drill can only use the battery from AVID POWER, please do not use a battery from other brand or a battery with a larger capacity

【Self-Tightening, Quick Installation】 Featuring a 3/8-inch keyless chuck that fits a wide range of drill bit sizes, this electric drill is your all-in-one solution for most basic household tasks. Beyond its convenience, the chuck's self-tightening design provides exceptional bit grip that securely hold bits without damaging or wearing down the shanks
【Work in Dark Area】 Featuring a built-in front LED light, the electric drill can reach into any dark corner to get your job done. Please note that it will light only when you press the speed trigger

【Gift for Family】 This house basic drill is a perfect gift for family who likes DIY jobs or house-repairing jobs. The drill set includes: 1x 12V drill, 1x 2.0Ah rechargeable battery, 1x 12V battery charger, 10x drill bits, 10x driver bits,and 1x extension bar. Note: tool case or bag is not included
